**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Screenshot
- **Click to capture the whole screen.** Press the Screenshot shortcut and just click anywhere instead of dragging a rectangle: the screen you clicked on is copied to the clipboard (and saved to your screenshot folder when that is turned on). Dragging a rectangle and Esc work as before.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.36...v8.37
